decision.explanation: Q01 is broadly similar to C04 (tight_bearing). The spectral-shape distance gives a clear ranking advantage to C04, and the figures support the same overall low-frequency-plus-narrow-high-frequency-carrier pattern with steady evolution and matching periodicity. The principal conflict is an upward carrier shift of roughly 0.12–0.23 kHz and a substantially different low/high band-power balance. C02 matches Q01 more closely in extreme-band fractions and the 5.3-Hz line, but its much worse 7.061-dB shape distance and less similar carrier detail make it secondary. Absolute FS levels are supporting only because acquisition gain is unknown.
